articles.title: U.S. Justice Department assembles force to shield against foreign AI threats
articles.snippet: The new DOJ task force will aid the recently designated U.S. "SI Force" by warding off bad actors backed by other nations, criminal groups or corporate fraud.

articles.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
articles.snippet: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

articles.title: Bitcoin miners are oversold following 35% October rout, VanEck says
articles.snippet: Investors dumped AI infrastructure providers across the board in October, treating companies in very different sectors as one monolithic trade.

articles.title: XRP Ledger fixes a disclosed bug that could have led to the creation of new tokens
articles.snippet: The fix went live Wednesday after validator support reset the activation clock in October. XRP itself was unaffected.

articles.title: Europe’s largest asset manager Amundi tokenizes equity index fund on Ethereum
articles.snippet: The new share class offers blockchain-based exposure to an index tracking 600 companies across European markets.
